rationale: C05 is an unmistakable annual predecessor and reusable template for the child. The operative language, subject, twenty-five-year extension mechanism, and congressional-reservation exception are virtually identical; the principal material change is the expiration year from 1949 to 1950. C25 is an equally clear but earlier iteration for 1948, while C04 shares only a similar disclaimer construction and does not supply the operative machinery.
